project.name: TCS Atlas — Governance Spine
project.description: Domain graph of the TCS Atlas governance spine: SOP > SWK > WI > Checklist > Action Plan > LMS, plus the CANON layer that authorizes the chain. Derived from .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json (34 nodes / 44 edges / 7 layers / 7 tour steps).

nodes.name: CANON / Governance
nodes.summary: Canonical authority that names what is real and how downstream pages must be authored. Houses ATLAS_TOKEN_REGISTRY.md (the resolver manifest) and SCHEMA.md (the wiki authoring law). Nothing downstream is legal unless it cites and conforms to CANON.

nodes.name: SOP — Standard Operating Procedure
nodes.summary: Umbrella operating doctrine. tcs-atlas.md names the four subsystems (registry, verification, watchdog, audits) and the order in which an operator engages them; index.md is the mandatory first read for any query. Establishes the procedural frame the rest of the spine works inside.

nodes.name: SWK — Standard Work Kit
nodes.summary: The canonical assets standard work consumes. atlas_token_registry.json (26,748 tokens / 53,317 aliases across atlas/atomics/graphify/legacy/pulse kinds) is the kit; atlas_token_xref.json is its lookup index; registry.md documents the kit. Every WI, checklist, and audit resolves against this.

nodes.name: WI — Work Instruction
nodes.summary: Procedural verification performed against the SWK. Resolver smoke test (atlas_token_resolver_smoke_2026-05-11.json) proves the kit resolves real tokens; the dated verification report (atlas_token_verification_2026-05-11.json) records the result; verification.md documents the WI procedure.

nodes.name: Checklist — Watchdog Cadence
nodes.summary: The WI repeated on a schedule. Six watchdog snapshots chained head-to-tail (08:44 -> 09:49 -> 12:48 -> 13:21 -> 14:22 -> 19:02 Z on 2026-05-11) — each captures one tick (registry pointer + resolutions map + scan counters). The 13:21 tick recorded 1,921 citations / 247 files / 495 unique tokens / zero unresolved.

nodes.name: Action Plan — Audits & Remediation
nodes.summary: Catch-and-fix triggered when the checklist surfaces a gap. BD5 audit at 19:57:52Z flagged CANON as missing_graph; BD5 audit at 19:59:32Z (same tick, +1 min later) records remediation: CANON finalized as the fifth formal M6 corpus (19 nodes / 34 edges / 4 confidence). audits.md documents the loop.

nodes.name: LMS — Learning Loop
nodes.summary: Codified learning surface. The supersession between the two BD5 audits is itself the captured lesson — an immune-system catch-and-fix preserved as institutional memory. SCHEMA.md (CANON) enforces the LMS contract: every new wiki page must register in index.md, so every lesson becomes a new SOP entry and the cycle closes.
nodes.notes: The LMS layer has no nodes exclusively at this layer in the current corpus; the LMS surface is materialized through (a) the supersession relationship between the two BD5 audits and (b) the SCHEMA.md convention that mandates index registration of every new page.

flows.name: CANON authorizes the SOP frame
flows.summary: ATLAS_TOKEN_REGISTRY.md (CANON) names the system that tcs-atlas.md (SOP) operationalizes; SCHEMA.md (CANON) mandates that every entity page be registered in index.md (SOP). The SOP layer cannot exist as procedural doctrine without the CANON contract.

flows.name: SOP delegates to the SWK kit
flows.summary: tcs-atlas.md (SOP) routes operators to registry.md (SWK entity page), which documents the canonical kit (atlas_token_registry.json + atlas_token_xref.json). The SOP names the work; the SWK supplies the asset against which the work resolves.

steps.label: SOP umbrella points at registry entity
SWK entity page describes the kit

flows.name: SWK is exercised by a WI
flows.summary: registry.md (SWK) hands off to verification.md (WI); the smoke test (atlas_token_resolver_smoke_2026-05-11.json) and the dated verification report (atlas_token_verification_2026-05-11.json) execute against atlas_token_registry.json. The kit becomes work when a WI exercises it.

steps.label: SWK entity points to verification WI

flows.name: WI becomes a repeating checklist
flows.summary: The first WI run (atlas_token_verification_2026-05-11.json) hands off to the first watchdog tick (08:44Z), which initiates a head-to-tail chain of six snapshots through 19:02Z on 2026-05-11. The WI's one-off becomes the checklist's heartbeat.

steps.label: WI report hands off to watchdog

flows.name: Checklist fires an Action Plan when a gap appears
flows.summary: When the watchdog cadence surfaces a missing_graph signal, the BD5 cross-corpus audit fires. 19:57:52Z audit flagged CANON missing; 19:59:32Z audit (same tick) records the remediation that finalized CANON as the fifth formal M6 corpus. The checklist's anomaly becomes the action plan's catch-and-fix.

flows.name: Action Plan feeds the LMS learning loop
flows.summary: The supersession between BD5_..195752Z (gap) and BD5_..195932Z (fix) is itself the lesson — institutional memory of a captured-and-closed immune-system event. audits.md (Action Plan entity) cross-links to tcs-atlas.md (SOP umbrella), and SCHEMA.md (CANON) requires every new page to register in index.md, closing the loop.

steps.label: SCHEMA mandates registration of every new page
Index updated; loop closes to SOP

flows.name: LMS feeds back into CANON (cycle closes)
flows.summary: SCHEMA.md is both a CANON artifact and the contract that converts an LMS-captured lesson into a new CANON page. New pages flow back through CANON -> SOP, so the spine is a closed cycle rather than a one-way pipe. The same artifact is the loop's terminator and its restart.

steps.label: Lesson promoted to a new page
